description: Source code for a backend PCAP writer class and related data structures, handling PCAP file operations, PDU creation, and network packet writing.

classes.name: pcap_pdu_data
classes.description: Represents a network Protocol Data Unit (PDU) with methods to construct UDP headers and payloads.

classes.name: backend_pcap_writer
classes.description: Handles writing PCAP files, including opening, closing, flushing, and writing PDUs and context PDUs.

methods.name: pcap_pdu_data::pcap_pdu_data
methods.description: Constructor that creates a UDP header and assembles the PDU payload.

methods.name: backend_pcap_writer::backend_pcap_writer
methods.description: Constructor initializing the PCAP writer with parameters like DLT, filename, and executor.

methods.name: backend_pcap_writer::~backend_pcap_writer
methods.description: Destructor that ensures the PCAP writer is closed.

methods.name: backend_pcap_writer::flush
methods.description: Flushes the PCAP data to disk if writing is enabled.

methods.name: backend_pcap_writer::flush_impl
methods.description: Implementation of flush, called within deferred task.

methods.name: backend_pcap_writer::close
methods.description: Closes the PCAP writer, dispatching the close operation to the backend executor.

methods.name: backend_pcap_writer::write_pdu
methods.description: Overloaded method to write a byte buffer or a pcap_pdu_data object as a PDU.

methods.name: backend_pcap_writer::write_pdu_impl
methods.description: Internal method to write a byte buffer PDU to the PCAP file.

methods.name: backend_pcap_writer::write_context_pdu_impl
methods.description: Internal method to write a context PDU with header and payload.
